pages.en:
This is not a battle. It is the disposal of a defeated soldier.

The fate of the vanquished.

From the beginning, a battle between Masters has meant killing or being killed. This is only the outcome one must accept. If a man cannot accept it, he should never have begun to fight.

And yet—
